svg.title: Four Checks Before Committing Closing Funds
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-statutory-risk-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Committing Closing Funds; subtitle: Each affirmative branch advances; unresolved evidence returns to diligence.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Apply jurisdiction-specific employment, tax, licensing, and secured-transactions rules to the actual deal structure. SBA requirements apply when using the relevant program; lender covenants and disclosure obligations depend on executed terms.; caption: Treat the four nodes as sequential decisions. An unresolved branch requires a documented cure, revised economics, or withdrawal before funds are committed.; stages: label: Can title transfer cleanly?; value: Yes: advance; unresolved: obtain releases; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Search applicable UCC filing offices and inspect liens outside that system. UCC § 9-315 generally preserves security interests after disposition unless an exception applies; obtain secured-party releases and payoff evidence.; label: Are tax terms executable?; value: Yes: advance; unresolved: revise closing terms; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For applicable asset acquisitions, align allocation and Form 8594 reporting under 26 U.S.C. § 1060. Review state successor-tax exposure, payroll remittances, clearance requirements, and tax-related indemnity support.; label: Can people and licenses continue?; value: Yes: advance; unresolved: cure continuity risks; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Test overtime exposure under 29 U.S.C. § 207, applicable WARN duties under §§ 2101–2102, state employment rules, and license transfer restrictions. Obtain required consents and verify customer assignment terms.; label: Does the debt structure survive stress?; value: Yes: proceed; unresolved: resize or withdraw; numeric value: 4.0; detail: For SBA transactions, review 13 CFR §§ 120.110, 120.150, and 120.160 plus current program requirements. Disclose seller notes and side agreements; stress principal, interest, customer loss, and covenant headroom.

rect.title: label: Can title transfer cleanly?; value: Yes: advance; unresolved: obtain releases; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Search applicable UCC filing offices and inspect liens outside that system. UCC § 9-315 generally preserves security interests after disposition unless an exception applies; obtain secured-party releases and payoff evidence.

rect.title: label: Are tax terms executable?; value: Yes: advance; unresolved: revise closing terms; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For applicable asset acquisitions, align allocation and Form 8594 reporting under 26 U.S.C. § 1060. Review state successor-tax exposure, payroll remittances, clearance requirements, and tax-related indemnity support.

text.title: For applicable asset acquisitions, align allocation and Form 8594 reporting under 26 U.S.C. § 1060. Review state successor-tax exposure, payroll remittances, clearance requirements, and tax-related indemnity support.

rect.title: label: Can people and licenses continue?; value: Yes: advance; unresolved: cure continuity risks; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Test overtime exposure under 29 U.S.C. § 207, applicable WARN duties under §§ 2101–2102, state employment rules, and license transfer restrictions. Obtain required consents and verify customer assignment terms.

text.title: Test overtime exposure under 29 U.S.C. § 207, applicable WARN duties under §§ 2101–2102, state employment rules, and license transfer restrictions. Obtain required consents and verify customer assignment terms.

rect.title: label: Does the debt structure survive stress?; value: Yes: proceed; unresolved: resize or withdraw; numeric value: 4.0; detail: For SBA transactions, review 13 CFR §§ 120.110, 120.150, and 120.160 plus current program requirements. Disclose seller notes and side agreements; stress principal, interest, customer loss, and covenant headroom.
